title: centaurea regia var. cynarocephala
intro: Centaurea regia var. cynarocephala, commonly known as the Cynarocephala or Crowned Cornflower, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family, characterized by its vibrant purple flowers and hairy foliage. The plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea regia var. cynarocephala include its ability to modulate the central nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
